comparison.objective: Orient and seat a gas-burner head around an igniter, then center and nest its cap.
comparison.physical_skill: Visually orients, aligns, inserts, and stacks two close-fitting rigid parts without a latch.
comparison.success_condition: Millimeter-scale centering, angular alignment, tilt, seating height, safe velocity, release, and stillness are required.
comparison.reason: This tests keyed nested placement. It has no unlocking, socket reacquisition, setting preservation, or repeated dynamic-response test, so shared rotation/alignment primitives do not establish overlap.
